The painting is currently housed in the **Louvre Museum** in Paris (Inventory No. 255).Key points:* **Artist** – Lorenzo Costa the Elder (c. 1460–1535).  * **Date** – circa 1505–1506.  * **Medium** – Tempera and oil on canvas.  * **Dimensions** – 164.5 cm (height) × 197.5 cm (width).  * **Location** – Louvre, Paris.  * **Provenance** – Initially part of Isabella d'Este’s studiolo in Mantua, then transferred to Paris, eventually arriving at the Louvre.There is **no documented “Younger” version** of this painting; the work attributed to the “elder” Lorenzo Costa remains the sole known version.  Any reference to “the Younger” in the search query likely conflates the artist’s familial distinction (Lorenzo Costa had a son also named Lorenzo Costa, referred to as *the Younger*) with the painting’s attribution.  The contemporary scholarship and inventories consistently identify the painting as the work of Lorenzo Costa the Elder.
